verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a local terminal, and its user data is portable. Configuration is a plain Lua file it watches and reloads, which users describe as easy to diff and sync with tools like chezmoi. Pane content and scrollback can be dumped as text with `wezterm cli get-text`, which a headless probe confirmed works. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of data export or portability as such, nothing on exporting session or multiplexer state, and only community and probe corroboration of the export path.
